title: Reports
summary: Numbers about your shop for the days you choose. Read them on the screen or download them for Excel.

sections.title: What is this page?
sections.intro: Reports answer questions like: How much did I sell this month? Which birds sell best? Which are slow? What am I about to run out of? Why do birds come back? Each report is one table with a short summary at the top.

blocks.title: In simple words
items: Reports use the same rules as your dashboard. A sale is an order that is fully paid and not cancelled, counted on the day it was placed.
A refund is a return that was finished, counted on the day it was confirmed.
You only see your own numbers.

blocks.title: How to
steps: Press the card of the report you want.
Choose the dates: "Last 7 days", "Last 30 days", "This month", "Last month", "This year", or type your own From and To.
Choose the options of that report (see below).
Read the summary and the table on the screen.
Press "Download CSV" to open it in Excel or Google Sheets.

blocks.text: You can choose at most 366 days at one time. If you choose "Low stock", the dates do not matter, because it shows your stock right now.

items: It shows money coming in: orders placed, paid orders, sales, refunds, and sales after refunds.
Choose to group by day or by month.
Use it to see which days or months are strong.

items.means: The products that earned the most. Returned items are left out.
Products on sale that sold least. It also shows when each last sold.
Active options with 5 or fewer left, or none. Add stock for these.

blocks.text: The list shows up to 100 rows.

items: It shows how many orders are in each step, and their share.
It shows how many were cancelled or returned.
It shows the average hours from "Confirmed" to "Delivered". A smaller number means you deliver faster.
Sales, then the system commission, then refunds, then the system commission that came back from returns.
The last line is what you keep: your share of the sales, minus refunds, plus the commission given back.
Choose to group by day or by month.

items.means: Why birds come back: not as described, damaged, wrong item and so on.

blocks.text: A high number for one reason is a clue. For example, many "not as described" means your description or pictures need work.

blocks.title: How to
steps: Open the file in Excel or Google Sheets.

blocks.text: The file has exactly what you see on the screen.

items.q: Why is a sale missing from my report?
items.a: It may not be fully paid yet. Record the payment on the order.

items.q: Why is a day missing in Sales?
items.a: Days with no sales are left out when you group by day.

items.q: Is the report the same as my dashboard?
items.a: Yes, with the same rules. If numbers look different, check that the dates are the same.
